Don't waste time setting up, as soon as it's plugged in, it will start inflating and will be ready for your garden. The six ground stakes, two drawstring and internal fan will keep this Santa stable when up. ● An inflatable Santa Claus riding a motorcycle and carrying gifts ● Four LED lights for a dazzling festive display ● Automatically inflates when the power is on ● Six ground stakes, two guy ropes and an internal fan for stability ● Water resistant polyester cloth. Certification: IP44, ideal for your front or back garden ● Assembly required Type: Santa carrying gifts on a motorcycle Colour: White, black, red and green Material: Polyester cloth Dimensions: 165H x 180W x 90Dcm. Cable length: 1.9m LED lighting power: 0.3W Fan: 1.5A Voltage: 220-240V/50HZ(Input), DC 12V/2A(Output) Certification: IP44,CE-EMC, Rohs Item Label: 844-242V70 NOTE: Please don't place it outdoor in hard rain or snow! Warning: this product is not a toy. Keep away from children unless under adult supervision. Keep away from open flames and heat sources. If powered, disconnect before cleaning or storage and do not use if damaged. Keep batteries away from children and dispose of used batteries safely. MH Star UK Ltd, 1 Northampton Cross Logistics Park, Northampton Cross Road, Northampton, NN4 9FH, United Kingdom
